items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q:
But the night that Duke played against
us was really a terrific battle.

ctx.x:
I remember one time he blowed --
Jimmy Lunceford was trying to fool
with Duke in Philly, and Duke really -- you know,
Jimmy had a terrific band that time.
Duke won that battle.

But the night that Duke played against
us was really a terrific battle. It was just a band
where two great bands were battling each other just
for the -- see what, you know --

The place was full of people and we
all knew that Chick -- Chick say, 'Look, well we're
gonna work this hard. The place is full. We (inaudible)
everybody. We can't get no more people up here.'
You know, 'you ain't gonna make no
more money. Just play.'
